label: Bible Study
prompt: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all _____.
verse: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
note: Eve's name sounds like the Hebrew word for 'living' — Adam named her with a hope, even after the fall.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in _____ there shall no evil touch thee.
verse: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
note: Six troubles, seven — however many come, Eliphaz says, no evil shall touch thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small _____ lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
verse: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared, and no small tempest lay on us, all hope that we should be saved was then taken away.
note: No sun, no stars, many days of tempest — just before Paul stood up and told everyone to be of good cheer.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: _____ ye, and believe the gospel.
verse: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
note: Jesus' first proclamation in Mark, in one breath: the time's up, the kingdom's here — turn around and believe.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy _____ hath made me great.
verse: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
note: David's victory song credits God's strength, not his own: 'thy gentleness hath made me great' — sung again in Psalm 18:35.
